title: Chibi Halloween Coaster PNG Bundle Vol. 2, Set of 4 Cute Kawaii Bat, Pumpkin, Witch & Skeleton Girls, Digital Download
description:
An adorable chibi quartet for Halloween lovers: a curly-haired bat-costume girl striking a superhero pose with a bag of candy, a sweet pumpkin-patch girl scooping seeds beside a grinning jack-o'-lantern, a starry witch stirring a bubbling green cauldron with her black cat, and a giggling skeleton-pajama girl dancing in a misty graveyard with friendly ghost lights.

✦ WHAT YOU GET
• 4 separate high-resolution PNG files (1254 x 1254 px)
• Ready for sublimation coasters, UV DTF printing, tumblers, and more
• Instant digital download — no physical item is shipped

✦ DESIGN NOTES
Kawaii chibi-style art with big sparkling eyes and warm autumn lighting give this set a cute, collectible feel that's a little different from our gothic-horror collections — perfect for anyone who wants their Halloween sweet instead of spooky.

✦ AI DISCLOSURE
These designs were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools as part of my creative process, then hand-curated, cleaned up, and prepared for print. This listing is a digital file only; no physical product is shipped.

✦ USAGE
For personal use and small-batch commercial use on physical items you make and sell (coasters, tumblers, apparel, etc.). Resale or redistribution of the digital files themselves is not permitted.

Thank you for shopping Dragon Oak Studio!
